Canara Bank has informed the Exchange that the Sub-Committee of the Board for Rights Issue has passed a Circular Resolution dated March 27, 2017 for allotment of Rights Issue of 5,42,99, 105 equity shares aggregating to Rs. 11,239.91 Million.Accordingly, the Bank would be taking steps to credit the equity shares and issue share certificates upon obtaining necessary approvals from the regulators.

Canara Bank has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as February 20, 2017 for the purpose of determining the shareholders eligible to apply for Rights Equity shares in the Issue.

IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'This is in reference to our earlier intimation dated May 15, 2019 about the Record Date in relation to the above.In this regard, we would like to inform that as per the Scheme ISL has allotted 1 (One) fully paid up Equity Share of Rs. 2/- each of ISL for every 1 (one) fully paid up Equity Shares of Rs. 2/- each held by shareholders of IIFL Finance Limited (ï¿½ï¿½IIFL Financeï¿½ï¿½) (Erstwhile IIFL Holdings Limited) and IWML has allotted 1(one) fully paid up Equity Shares of Rs. 2/- each of IWML for every 7 (Seven) fully paid up Equity Shares of Rs. 2/- each held by the shareholders of IIFL Finance on June 06, 2019.The credit of the said shares has been completed into the Demat Account of the shareholders. For the shareholders holding physical share certificates, the share certificates of ISL and IWML will be dispatched in due course.  We request you to take this on record and oblige.'.

IIFL Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'We are in receipt of a number of queries from investors regarding behaviour in todayï¿½ï¿½s share price of IIFL Finance Limited (Formerly known as IIFL Holdings Limited). This is to inform all the stakeholders that from today, IIFLï¿½ï¿½s stock is trading after giving effect of demerger of IIFL Wealth Management Limited and IIFL Securities Limited in terms of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. All the shareholders who bought shares till yesterday will be allotted shares of IIFL Securities Ltd and IIFL Wealth Management Ltd in about a weekï¿½ï¿½s time and the said Companies will be listed at National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Ltd in due course of time upon receipt of necessary approvals from Stock Exchanges and SEBI.Post listing and commencement of trading in the shares of aforesaid two entities, the aggregate value of all three listed entities put together will reflect the value of erstwhile IIFL Holdings Limited.Further, as informed earlier, the name of the Company has been changed from IIFL Holdings Limited to IIFL Finance Limited w.e.f. May 24, 2019 after giving effect to aforesaid demerger. The said change in name will reflect on the websites of BSE and NSE w.e.f. June 04, 2019.We request you to take this on record and oblige. '.
